The '''astronavigation droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] produced by [[Golden Nyss Shipyards]]. [[NT 600]] was the astronavigation droid of the [[Inferno (Vilmarh Grahrk)|''Inferno'']], the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vilmarh Grahrk]].
